purpose: Small read-only evidence index for the eventual final goal report; not a trial verdict.

claims.fact: Trusted code binds an omitted worktree to the canonical snapshot project. Native v12 relations belong to their containing claim and target disclosed existing claims. Mixed layouts, invalid targets and old indexed endpoints reject rather than being salvaged.
claims.demonstrates: Current implementation fixes structural origin and membership contracts.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Not proof that a generated relation is semantically correct; canonical injected runners keep their separate format.

claims.fact: Five retained development outputs failed unchanged; explicit v11 wire migration processed all five in the historical replay.
claims.demonstrates: Known producer/storage mismatches were reproducible without new model outputs.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: This historical migration is not current v12 acceptance, a repaired old grade, or a fresh quality result.

claims.fact: Judge decoding validates exact question/fact coverage before persistence. Reader catalogs validate each displayed quote against its own canonical field, role and interval; native command/output fields stay distinct.
claims.demonstrates: Malformed coverage and source references fail validation; no missing judgment is fabricated.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Structural witness validation cannot itself prove entailment, source truth, useful recall, or absence of judge error.

claims.fact: Material fields are assembled from their own disclosed exact source sentences with role, interval and partial-context metadata. Carried prior_* fields are rebuilt from their own references. When quality assessment is enabled, it sees final prepared fields; commit reconstructs and checks the same prepared digest with source/head/revision fences.
claims.demonstrates: Assessment and committed representations are bound; exact assembly prevents unsupported model prose being stored as a direct quotation.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: A correct quotation does not establish the correct semantic field, current applicability, external truth or complete source coverage.

claims.fact: In the disclosed 24-case probe, existing support assessment accepted 12/12 irrelevant field assignments. The purpose probe accepted none of those 12, but left 8/12 useful fields uncertain; a quarantine policy would withhold those useful fields. There were 10 unresolved decisions overall.
claims.demonstrates: Source support and field purpose are separate dimensions. The purpose probe reduced explicit false acceptance while creating substantial unresolved useful material.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Not an independent holdout or end-to-end reader evaluation. The eight useful losses are hypothetical blocking-policy losses, not observed production deletions. The original failed attempt and one unknown-usage attempt remain disclosed.

claims.fact: The assessment explicitly rejects adding the narrow purpose check as a blocking production gate. Code defaults jev_quality_enabled to false; the processor assesses only when enabled. The existing .8/.2 thresholds were not lowered.
claims.demonstrates: A documented decision and default configuration preserve nonblocking behavior instead of treating unresolved useful fields as expendable.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: This synthesis did not inspect installed project settings or service state. Default-off is not proof of every live configuration; semantic misassociation remains a limitation.

groups.topic: Requirement fate, versions, retraction and continuation

claims.fact: Consumed user material receives neutral source custody. Whole-source exact-text eligible claims can mark representation stored; scoped closing relations can mark completion. Partial clauses, paraphrases and replacement remain unresolved. The cancelled counter has no inference path and stays zero.
claims.demonstrates: Processing or disappearance of a fast signal no longer alone implies represented meaning. A retained original can expose an unresolved remainder after partial cancellation.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Custody is not an active requirement or approval. This is conservative fate coverage, not complete semantic cancellation extraction; no historical backfill is promised.

claims.fact: Continuation/consolidation requires positively supported explicit task identity, not shared topic or chat membership. Recognized affirmative reopening can carry a bounded reason/purpose. New immutable heads retain prior_* source-backed history with current validity unresolved. Source deletion revokes dependent objects and fences jobs.
claims.demonstrates: Bounded cross-chat continuity, explicit history qualification and dependency invalidation exist in code.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Unrecognized wording remains unresolved. A historical quotation does not reactivate a requirement; immutable versions do not prove that semantic task identity or every requirement was recovered.

claims.fact: The native path conservatively downgrades unsupported acceptance/completion to proposed state and omits unsupported closing/replacement transitions while retaining valid proposals. Reconciliation counts disclose the uncertainty.
claims.demonstrates: The source and scope checks can prevent an unproved transition from silently changing existing work.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: These syntactic/domain guards do not establish external completion or replace semantic review. Silence and processed coverage are not closure evidence.

groups.topic: Retrieval, budgets, citations and query planning

claims.fact: One final renderer serves public rendering and brief construction. It compacts an existing primary selection, declares quote_refs=provenance_only, and refills only whole complementary groups. Association qualifiers remain local. Atomic command/output/exit provenance and own source ID/role/field/tool-use ID/offsets remain. Neutral pools and whole-group budgets stay bounded.
claims.demonstrates: Exact wire accounting reduces repeated metadata without treating quotation sharing as applicability. Refill does not evict the resulting primary selection.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Not maximal packing. If the mandatory declaration cannot fit, one primary retry reserves its real cost; universal parity with the earlier primary selection is not promised. Useful competing evidence can still be omitted.

claims.fact: A disclosed frozen-DTO V7 replay covered 96 views / 108 owners. Old source spans 772 became 874; 141 intervals were gained, but 26 old spans were not fully covered (23 lost intervals / 2640 characters). Context characters changed from 541465 to 519996.
claims.demonstrates: Mechanical transport changes and every measured interval loss were retained, with source field/role/tool identity checked separately.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: No query acquisition ran in that replay. Old body/output field substitution cannot mask losses. Mechanical same-source mirror visibility is not semantic recall, an independent holdout, or a quality pass.

claims.fact: Caller-selected enabled absolute paths remain separate from content. Unique selected aliases can normalize in bounded natural grammar, including trusted period-ended scope prefixes. Quotes, commands, calls, paths, code/task/version/environment terms, collisions and explicit unknown scope labels retain hard identity. Safe unquoted alphabetic modifier compounds split only for lexical matching.
claims.demonstrates: The latest offline receipt records 139 targeted checks and a disclosed 96-context R19 replay with zero lost previously visible intervals, three source-visibility gain contexts and 13 changed contexts.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: No project discovery or owner expansion. Ordinary unmarked lowercase names and names before ordinary-looking heads can be ambiguous; the following word is not proven to be a noun. No R20 outcome or fresh semantic quality is inferred.

claims.fact: Reads call no model and expose incomplete/observational coverage and omissions. Exact task, owner, environment, version, session, privacy and deletion boundaries remain. Some historical requests still return historical_query before acquisition; prior diagnosis found canonical sources present behind that guard.
claims.demonstrates: Source presence, admission, packing, reader visibility and answer support remain separate stages. Capture sequence can order observations without proving event time or identity.
claims.does_not_demonstrate: Bounded neutral originals are not necessarily relevant or currently applicable. A source in Store does not guarantee delivery; delivered quotes do not guarantee a correct next action.

non_verdict: Implementation, regression and disclosed replay evidence is indexed separately from the fresh answer-quality gates. No prediction, pass, regrade or relaxed criterion is asserted.
